name: reads
description: The read language: joins on shared variables, OPTIONAL pads rather than drops, NOT asks about the record and never about the world, typed comparison, nulls last, deterministic paging.

cases.name: a tuple pattern binds both ends and joins on them
NOT keeps what the pattern could not extend
UNION widens rather than filtering
a comparison between unlike types decides nothing
nulls sort last under ASC
cases.command: FIND(?c.name) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {type: "Person"} } ORDER BY ?c.attributes.display_name ASC

cases.name: nulls sort last under DESC too, because absent is not a large value
cases.command: FIND(?c.name) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {type: "Person"} } ORDER BY ?c.attributes.display_name DESC

cases.name: a missing attribute reads as null, not as an error
COUNT over nothing is zero, and zero is not a falsehood
an archived element is out of recall by default
a bare variable projects the whole element
a cursor a caller invented is malformed, whatever it is spelled as
and a number is the same refusal: a cursor is opaque, never a position a caller can type
grouping is implicit: the non-aggregated projected expressions are the key
cases.command: FIND(?c.name, COUNT(?p)) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {type: "Person"}  ?p (?c, "prefers", ?o) } ORDER BY ?c.name

cases.name: and a FIND of aggregates alone is one global group
ORDER BY rejects an aggregate that is not projected
cases.command: FIND(?c.name) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {type: "Person"} } ORDER BY COUNT(?c) DESC, ?c.name

cases.name: but a sort key that varies inside a group has no value to sort by
cases.command: FIND(?c.name, COUNT(?c)) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {type: "Person"} } ORDER BY ?c.attributes.display_name

cases.name: a bounded aggregate takes groups in a repeatable order, so the cut is the same twice
cases.command: FIND(?c.name, COUNT(?c)) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {type: "Person"} } ORDER BY ?c.name LIMIT 1

Option.description: A preference option used by these fixtures. A real Space types each option by its kind (Profile §5.5, §7), because prefers partitions by the option's Concept Type; one catch-all type is one partition.
